newsHighlights.title: See you next time, Shenzhen!
newsHighlights.summary: A city of innovation, a vibrant cityscape and warm hospitality have given visitors from around the world plenty of reasons to fall in love with Shenzhen as APEC China 2026 drew to a close.
newsHighlights.translation: 创新之城、充满活力的城市风貌与热情好客，让来自世界各地的来宾在APEC中国2026落幕之际爱上了深圳。

newsHighlights.title: Peng champions cultural bonds, mutual learning
newsHighlights.summary: Peng Liyuan championed cultural bonds and mutual learning, calling for deeper people-to-people exchanges across the Asia-Pacific.
newsHighlights.translation: 彭丽媛倡导文化纽带与文明互鉴，呼吁亚太地区深化人文交流。

newsHighlights.title: Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op based on solidarity, openness, innovation
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi called for inclusive regional cooperation built on solidarity, openness and innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席呼吁构建基于团结、开放与创新的包容性区域合作。

newsHighlights.title: Wang Yi: APEC Shenzhen meeting a new peak in Asia-Pacific cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: Wang Yi said the APEC Shenzhen meeting marks a new peak in Asia-Pacific cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 王毅表示，APEC深圳会议是亚太合作的新高峰。

quote.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 旅行让人接触不同的文化、风景与人群，拓宽视野。正如APEC来宾在深圳感受到的城市魅力，走出国门、拥抱世界才能读懂人类文明的丰富多样。

pattern.pattern: give sb plenty of reasons to do sth（给某人充分的理由去做某事）
pattern.example: Shenzhen has given visitors from around the world plenty of reasons to fall in love with the city.
pattern.translation: 深圳给了世界各地的来宾充分的理由爱上这座城市。
pattern.usage: reasons 后可接 to do 不定式表示做某事的理由，也可改为 plenty of reason to do。可用于描述城市、文化、美食、展览等给人留下的印象，例如 The museum gives tourists plenty of reasons to stay longer.

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）：过去动作对现在造成的影响
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词构成，强调过去发生的动作对现在产生的结果或影响，常与 already、yet、just、so far 等时间状语连用。在新闻英语中常用来描述事件带来的持续影响。
examples: Shenzhen has given visitors from around the world plenty of reasons to fall in love with the city.
APEC Shenzhen meeting has become a new peak in Asia-Pacific cooperation.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 /tæ/ 上，注意词中字母 t 在快速语流中常弱化为闪音。前三个音节读得较轻、较快，/ˌhɒs-/ 弱读为 /həs/。可拆分为 hos-pi-TAL-i-ty 慢读四遍后再连读。
examples: The city is famous for its warm hospitality.
We were moved by the hospitality of the local people.

reading.title: Shenzhen Says Goodbye to APEC Guests
reading.content: As APEC China 2026 drew to a close, Shenzhen said goodbye to guests from across the Asia-Pacific. The southern city gave visitors plenty of reasons to fall in love with it: innovation, a vibrant cityscape and warm hospitality. Many guests walked along the waterfront, visited technology museums and tasted local Cantonese food. But the meeting was not only about trade and business. Cultural events encouraged mutual learning among civilizations, and people-to-people exchanges added fresh momentum to regional friendship. Guests said Shenzhen showed how a modern city can stay open and welcoming at the same time. As one visitor put it, arriving as a guest and leaving as a friend is the best memory of a journey. See you next time, Shenzhen!
reading.translation: 随着APEC中国2026落下帷幕，深圳向来自亚太各地的来宾道别。这座南方城市给了来宾们爱上它的充分理由：创新、充满活力的市容和热情好客。许多来宾漫步海滨、参观科技馆、品尝粤菜。但此次会议不仅关乎贸易与商务。文化活动促进了文明互鉴，人文交流为地区友谊注入了新的动力。来宾们表示，深圳展示了一座现代城市如何同时保持开放与友好。正如一位来宾所说：以客人的身份到来，以朋友的身份离开，是一段旅程中最美好的回忆。深圳，下次再见！
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily《See you next time, Shenzhen!》《Peng champions cultural bonds, mutual learning》等APEC相关报道改写，用于英语学习目的。
